name: Burkina Faso
description: Burkina Faso from the Mossi kingdoms to French Upper Volta, independence in 1960, Thomas Sankara and the coups and insurgency of today.

checkpoints.name: The Mossi
checkpoints.note: The Mossi kingdoms ruled the plateau around Ouagadougou for centuries.

checkpoints.name: Upper Volta
checkpoints.note: France conquered the Mossi in 1896, and the land became the colony of Upper Volta.

checkpoints.name: Upper Volta to Burkina
checkpoints.note: Independence came in 1960. Thomas Sankara took power in 1983 and renamed the country before he was killed in 1987.

checkpoints.name: Compaoré and after
checkpoints.note: Compaoré ruled until 2014. Since 2015 jihadist attacks and two coups in 2022 have shaken the country.
